scenes.text: Guess the price of this one scoop of ice cream.
It's called Black Diamond, and a Dubai cafe sold it for eight hundred seventeen dollars.
The base is Madagascar vanilla, with Italian truffles.
Then Iranian saffron and twenty-three karat gold flakes.
It came in a Versace bowl with a matching spoon, and you kept both.
Would you pay eight hundred seventeen dollars for one scoop? Follow for more jewelry on a plate.
